sources.summary:
Screen readers can now navigate issue and pull request timelines as a list. When you move through a timeline, assistive technology can announce the list structure, item count, current position,…
Screen readers can now navigate issue and pull request timelines as a list. When you move through a timeline, assistive technology can announce the list structure, item count, current position, and how to move between events. This makes it easier to understand long histories and jump to relevant updates

sources.title: Zenity 研究人员发现一条提示词即可劫持 AWS 账户内全部 AgentCore 智能体 / A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found
sources.title_zh: Zenity 研究人员发现一条提示词即可劫持 AWS 账户内全部 AgentCore 智能体
sources.title_en: A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found
sources.title_original: A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found
sources.summary: Zenity Labs 研究人员披露名为 AgentCorruption 的漏洞链，只需对一个公开的 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 智能体发送一条提示词，即可通过元数据服务 169.254.169.254 窃取其 AWS 凭据，进而控制同账户同区域内的所有 AgentCore 智能体，读取私人对话、源代码和存储的凭据，还能篡改长期记忆。

sources.title_zh: Waymo 完成 50 亿美元债务融资，加速业务扩张
sources.title_en: Waymo Closes $5 Billion Debt Financing to Accelerate Business Expansion
sources.title_original: Waymo Closes $5 Billion Debt Financing to Accelerate Business Expansion
sources.summary: Waymo 宣布完成 50 亿美元定期贷款，这是其首次债务融资。PIMCO、Blackstone 和 Sixth Street 担任牵头银团贷方，Goldman Sachs 担任独家主账簿管理人；资金将用于加速其全自动驾驶打车服务在美国及国际市场的扩张。此前今年早些时候 Waymo 完成了 160 亿美元股权融资，上个月刚在第十五个美国城市启动服务。

primary_item.summary: Anthropic 宣布将 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的缓存读取价格减半，降至每百万 token $0.10。官方称这使 Sonnet 5.5 在多数长期运行任务上的运行成本降低约 20%。
